about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Bartholomew the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We have received, O Lord, the pledge of everlasting redemption; may it, by the intercession of blessed Bartholomew, Your Apostle, be our help both now and in the life to come. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
